"""Show the measured scalar-angle discontinuity in a teacher episode."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
r = json.loads(Path('runs/quality-research/navigation-label-counterexample.json').read_text())
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4), layout='constrained')
names = ['0.0 s', '0.1 s']
colors = ['#167b78', '#b56820']
samples = [r['before'], r['after']]
axes[0].bar(names, [sample['action'][3] for sample in samples], color=colors, width=.4)
axes[0].set(title='Existing target: signed yaw / π', ylabel='Regression label', ylim=(-1.15, 1.15))
axes[0].axhline(0, color='#555555', linewidth=.7)
for index, sample in enumerate(samples):
    heading = sample['decoded_world_heading_xz']
    axes[1].scatter([0, 1], heading, color=colors[index], marker=['o', 'x'][index], s=90, label=names[index])
axes[1].set(title='Decoded world heading barely changes', xticks=[0, 1], xticklabels=['X', 'Z'], ylim=(-.15, 1.15), xlim=(-.5, 1.5), ylabel='Unit-vector component')
axes[1].legend()
for axis in axes:
    axis.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
    axis.grid(axis='y', alpha=.15)
fig.suptitle('Measured teacher labels: house route, seed 0\nNative diagnostic; this does not establish the cause of every training failure')
fig.savefig('docs/progress/drone-heading-labels.png', dpi=140)
